# Image Upscaler

Image upscaler: enlarge, enhance and sharpen an image from your MegaScenes library to 2x or 4x for print, wallpapers and 4K screens. The larger file is generated in seconds.

## What it does
Pick a picture from your MegaScenes library (upload one in the Studio, or make one with the Image plugin) and choose 2x or 4x. Claude tells you the price and returns the larger file.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Starts from a picture in your MegaScenes library: upload one in the Studio, or make one first.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image-upscaler@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/upscale/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_upscale_models` | Models for upscaled images with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_upscale_cost` | Exact price of one upscaled image before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_upscale` | Starts one upscaled image in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_upscale` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Upscale my latest logo to 4x for print"
- "Make the mountain lake image sharp enough for a 4K wallpaper"
- "Enhance the portrait I made earlier"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
